title: Post-Course Self-Assessment
description: Rate yourself on the same seven competencies you rated at the start. Compare with your pre-course answers. Ungraded; one attempt.

questions.text: **Computational thinking.** I can break a creative task (a song, a scene) into ordered steps a tool could act on.
**Prompt engineering.** I can write a prompt that specifies genre, mood, structure, and constraints and get close to what I imagined.
**Problem solving.** When an AI output misses the mark, I know at least two ways to fix it.
**Creativity and innovation.** I can combine AI output with my own artistry to make something original.
**AI feedback evaluation.** I can judge whether an AI-generated piece or suggestion is accurate, high quality, and appropriate.
**AI ethics literacy.** I can explain the ownership, consent, bias, and disclosure issues raised by GenAI in the arts.
**Collaboration.** I am comfortable sharing drafts in a digital space and giving peers constructive feedback.
Which competency grew the most, and which artifact is the best evidence of that growth? Two or three sentences.
What is one thing about this course you would change, and one thing you would keep? This feedback shapes the next offering.
